candidates.change_summary: Removed the nonReentrant_ modifier from Put so reentrancy and locking behavior differs, which can change Acc[msg.sender].balance after Put completes.
Modifier nonReentrant_ changed to set locked_ = false before function body (allowing reentrancy during body) which can alter final state after Put completes.
Change acc.balance update to add only half of msg.value, modifying observable balance after Put.
Modify the nonReentrant_ modifier to not reset the lock after execution (removes unlocking), causing subsequent calls (including Collect) to be blocked.
Change Collect to perform the external call before checking conditions, allowing a different observable behavior by potentially sending funds even when conditions fail.
Change Collect to update acc.balance before performing the external call, altering observable state if the external call reenters or fails.
